caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular piece of fabric, likely a blanket or a cloth, which is shown folded neatly with the top right corner aligned almost parallel to the edges of the drawing. The fabric has a textured surface with a repeating small, square-like pattern covering the central area. Along the left and bottom edges of the rectangle, there is a decorative crocheted or knitted border with a scalloped edge and openwork designs that form a regular pattern of holes and arches. The fabric and the border are both rendered in shades of light gray, giving the appearance of a monochromatic color scheme, possibly representing white or light-colored yarn. The drawing is presented on a plain, off-white background, and the artist's signature "W.W. Jennings" appears in small, uppercase letters in the bottom right corner within the border of the outlined illustration.
